input: My VPN keeps cutting out at home. What can I try?
answer: Here are the steps to try:  1. **Check your NorthLink version** – Make sure you're running version 5.2 or later, as older versions drop the connection on weak Wi-Fi [2].  2. **Improve your Wi-Fi signal** – Move closer to your router or connect with a network cable instead [2].  3. **Change the protocol** – Switch the protocol in NorthLink settings from "Auto" to "TCP". It comes pre-installed with disk encryption, antivirus, and the company VPN [2].  New starters also receive a headset, and a docking station if they work on site [3].  If you need a Developer laptop instead (16-inch with 32 GB memory), that requires director approval [3].

input: I forgot my password and cannot sign in. What do I do?
answer: To reset your forgotten password, follow these steps [1]:  1. Go to the self-service page at reset.northwind.example. 2. Enter your work email and approve the MFA prompt. 3. Choose a new password that meets the policy requirements (at least 14 characters, and not reusing any of your last 10 passwords) [1].  If you cannot pass the MFA step, contact the service desk. They will verify your identity with your manager before resetting your password [3].

input: What does error VPN-806 mean?
answer: Error VPN-806 means the VPN client cannot find a VPN certificate on your laptop. This usually happens after a laptop is rebuilt. To fix it, raise a ticket to have a new certificate issued; it takes about 1 business day. [1][3]

input: What is VPN-815?
answer: VPN-815 is a connection error that occurs when the VPN connection was blocked because it came from a country on the restricted list [1]. To resolve this, you need to contact the security team; access can only be opened after they approve your travel [1].

input: A visitor got WIFI-117 on the guest network. What does that mean?
answer: According to the error code documentation, WIFI-117 means "Guest access expired" [1].   Guest Wi-Fi access lasts 8 hours. After that, the guest must register again at the reception kiosk to get a new code [1].

answer: ACC-409 means your password has expired and must be changed before you can sign in [1].  To fix it: 1. Change your password from the self-service portal 2. Make sure your new password follows the password policy [1]  Then you'll be able to sign in again.

input: And on a Mac?
answer: To install NorthLink VPN on a Mac [2]:  1. Open Self Service and install "NorthLink VPN". 2. Approve the system extension in System Settings > Privacy & Security, then restart the Mac once. 3. Start NorthLink, use the server address vpn.northwind.example, and sign in with your work email and password, then approve the MFA prompt [2].

input: morning! so i'm leaving the company on friday, when do my logins get switched off?
answer: Good morning! According to the policy, your accounts will be disabled by 18:00 on your last working day [1]. So if Friday is your last day, your logins will be switched off by 18:00 that day.  Your manager should have raised a leaver ticket at least 3 working days in advance to make sure this happens on time [1].
